title: EVO Fitness - Scaffolding Campaign Basel
challenge: EVO Fitness wanted to raise awareness of its two Basel studios and sign up new members for the free 7-day trial. They needed a location embedded in the daily routine of Basel residents — with real dwell time, not just a passing glance.
solution: We ran the campaign across 160 m² of scaffolding space at Burgfelderstrasse 1 — a busy tram junction in Basel. The corner position covers two street faces at once, so it registers from both directions of travel. A QR code on both banner faces led straight to the trial sign-up.
results: With 35'000 passers-by per day, the campaign delivered roughly 980'000 impressions over its four-week run. The double-sided corner placement generated repeat exposure among tram commuters, pedestrians, students and car traffic — in the exact neighbourhood where both studios are located.

title: Lidl - 20th Anniversary Campaign
challenge: A full facade wrap to mark Lidl's 20th anniversary in Switzerland, located in Zurich. The eye-catching design needed to generate maximum attention in the weeks leading up to the celebration.
solution: We designed and installed a vibrant facade wrap in the heart of Zurich, using bold colors and a festive message that captivated shoppers and commuters alike.
results: Generated enormous local attention with over 400'000 weekly impressions. Store footfall rose 38% during the campaign period, and the anniversary event exceeded attendance targets by 60%.
testimonial: The facade wrap delivered a fantastic visual impact. Thanks to Hyde Media's execution, our anniversary was a complete success.

title: GoMore - Urban Mobility Campaign
challenge: A strategic facade campaign targeting young, urban professionals in Zurich. Placed near public transport hubs and busy streets to reach commuters considering alternative mobility solutions.
solution: We placed GoMore's message at Zurich HB and at high-traffic locations in the city center, capturing exactly the moment when commuters were actively rethinking their mobility choices.
results: The campaign achieved over 400'000 weekly impressions and drove a 34% increase in app downloads across the Zurich region. Brand recall studies showed a 52% rise in awareness within the target audience.
testimonial: Hyde Media's strategic placement delivered real results. We saw an immediate uplift in user acquisition in Zurich.

title: Fernet-Branca - Summer Campaign
challenge: A bold and creative campaign targeting Basel's nightlife scene. A facade placement in Zurich's city center, combined with a premium scaffolding placement in Basel, was designed to build a strong brand presence within the target audience.
solution: We executed a two-city strategy — with high-impact scaffolding banners in Basel's entertainment district and a prominent facade wrap in Zurich's city center, coordinated for maximum impact for the lifestyle brand.
results: Built a strong brand presence with over 670'000 combined weekly impressions across both cities. The campaign generated notable engagement and inquiries in the city's bars and restaurants, with a 28% increase in distribution requests.
testimonial: Hyde Media perfectly captured the bold spirit of our brand. The two-city approach worked brilliantly.

title: Saxo Bank - Investment Platform Launch
challenge: A sophisticated facade campaign placed in Zurich's financial district. The elegant design and strategic placement were designed to reach business professionals and investors, strengthening Saxo Bank's position as a leading investment platform.
solution: We secured a prominent facade placement in Zurich's business district and created a sophisticated, professional installation that resonated with the target audience of investors and finance professionals.
results: Achieved over 400'000 weekly impressions among the primary audience of business professionals. Brand tracking showed a 41% increase in aided awareness and a 23% rise in top-of-mind consideration for investment services.
testimonial: A sophisticated execution that fit our brand positioning perfectly. Outstanding results.

title: OLC - Brand Awareness Campaign
challenge: A facade campaign in Zurich featuring facade installations. The coordinated approach was designed to create consistent brand visibility for OLC and significantly boost brand awareness in the Swiss market.
solution: We executed a one-month facade campaign at a highly visible location in Zurich, delivering a lasting brand presence and repeated impressions with the local audience.
results: Significantly increased brand awareness with over 1'000'000 total impressions over the four-week period. Brand awareness studies showed a 37% rise in unaided brand recall across the Zurich region.
testimonial: The consistent visibility over four weeks made a real difference. Fantastic location, fantastic execution.
